text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped by about five hours a week per rep. That meant more selling, or at least earlier dinners.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, searchable, and actually completed. Managers could finally see why deals stalled.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking consent upfront, and explaining how the data is used, turned most skeptics into non-issues.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Coaching conversations still needed a human.

**5. Adoption followed champions.** Usage spread when top reps shared real examples, not when we sent training decks.

Our verdict: keep it, with guardrails.

What did your team learn from piloting AI tools?
